translations.web: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them; for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
translations.bsb: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the count, because the king’s command was detestable to him.
translations.kjv: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
